annotation.title_clean: Increased Maximum Penalties under the Amendments to the Air Navigation Act
annotation.title_en: Increased Maximum Penalties under the Amendments to the Air Navigation Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport / Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Government announcement of the Air Navigation (Amendment) Bill 2019 in Singapore, which raises maximum fines and imprisonment terms for offences involving unmanned aircraft, such as unauthorised operation, overflight of protected areas, endangering others, and non-compliance with authorised persons' directions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operating without required permits: first offence up to $50,000 and/or 2 years; repeat up to $100,000 and/or 5 years
Unauthorised photography or overflight of protected areas: penalties raised to up to $100,000 and/or 5 years
Endangering life or property with a UA: up to 10 years' imprisonment
Non-compliance with authorised persons' directions: imprisonment raised from 12 months to 2 years
Discharging substances from a UA without a permit remains fined up to $20,000
